title: Yummy Peppery Croatian Smoked Mackerel Pasta
description: A quick and delicious Croatian dish featuring smoked mackerel, this peppery and creamy pasta is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is low in calories and can be prepared in no time.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the smoked mackerel to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the black pepper, paprika, and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, mix the low-fat sour cream with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the pan with the mackerel mixture, tossing everything together until the pasta is well coated.
Stir in the sour cream mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
